register.rule: daily change in the Yes price of 'Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?' read at 12:00 UTC (the last hourly point at or before 12:00:00 UTC; hourly points are stamped seconds after the hour, so in practice the 11:00 UTC sample) vs next-day Brent (BZ=F) log return, controlling for Brent's own same-day log return: OLS of the next-day return on [change, same-day return] with an intercept, Newey-West t with 5 lags; the slope and t are those of the change
register.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
register.pass_mark: slope < 0 and t < -2 over at least 60 trading days after 2026-10-28
register.calendar: the asset's own trading days (dates with a Brent close in the World file)
